scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter site run deploy

DB.description: D1 database for EmDash content, plugin storage, the token refresh lock and service-auth replay protection.

LOADER.description: Worker Loader. Runs the sandboxed plugin and each WebAssembly module in its own isolate. Needs the **Workers Paid** plan.

EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts EmDash plugin secrets at rest. Generate one with `echo emdash_enc_v1_$(openssl rand 32 | base64 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')` and keep a copy: losing it loses the secrets.
